contentText: After eight years of development by Rockstar Games and multiple delays, the 6th installment of the world's most talked-about game Grand Theft Auto is being released this Thursday, November 19. The game, founded nearly three decades ago and built around stealing cars and outrunning the police, boasts some 500 million sales, and this time is preparing for yet another big score, as millions of fans around the world get ready for its launch.
